AVT – Applied Vocational Training offers nationally recognised animal care, veterinary nursing, equine care, and animal behaviour and training courses across Australia. Whether you’re just starting out, changing careers, or looking to upskill, our online and in-person training will help you launch a rewarding career working with animals. 

Subscribe to explore course previews, student stories, tips from industry, and advice on careers.

About us: Registered Training Organisation RTO No. 5273
AVT is a Perth, WA based training organisation. Our qualifications are written by our team of qualified Veterinarians, Veterinary Nurses and Animal Scientists. Our educators are active members of either the veterinary profession or are involved in the animal care industry. They have extensive experience teaching in University and TAFE programs. We work closely with industry partners such as the RSPCA, Dogs' Refuge Home, Cat Haven,  Vetpartners, Greencross and many more well-respected workplaces.
